rules.statement: A step is shown only when its prerequisites are known; the progress indicator names completed steps as text, not colour alone.
Payment states are a closed vocabulary (idle, authorising, authorised, captured, declined, requires-action, unknown) and each has its own copy; unknown is a state, not an error.

Duplicate-submit checklist, all required: the submit control disables on press; the guard is in the handler as well as the UI; the request carries an idempotency key; a retry reuses the same key; a resumed session re-checks the order state before re-submitting.
A declined or failed payment preserves the cart, the address and the chosen method, and never returns the shopper to an empty step.
Countdowns or reservation timers appear only when a real reservation exists, and the reserved time is stated as a fact from the server.

stateMachine.staleResponseRule: a payment status for a superseded attempt is ignored; unknown status polls are bounded and then surfaced as unknown rather than as failure
